audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] states "Tryndamere's Spinning Slash (E) resets on kills".
audit.why: Spinning Slash has no kill reset. It is 12/11/10/9/8 seconds, and critical strikes reduce the current cooldown by 0.75s, doubled to 1.5s against champions. This is not a pedantic difference: it means Tryndamere buys his escape back by landing crits on Zac during the fight, so denying crits during the engage — not avoiding kills near him — is what strands him. The current line points the player at a mechanic that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text with the real cooldown and the crit-reduction rule.
sources: League Wiki, Tryndamere: "Critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds, doubled to 1.5 seconds against champions"

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is never mentioned in the content layer.
audit.why: It reduces bonus attack damage, which is almost nothing against Zac — his damage is Unstable Matter, a percentage of max health dealt as magic. The half that does apply is the slow, and it only lands on enemies facing away from Tryndamere. That gives a concrete movement rule: walk through him rather than retreating, and the slow never applies. Worth stating precisely because the instinct in a losing melee trade is to turn and run, which is the one action that arms it.
audit.corrected: Added to whys[1] and mid as the walk-through-him rule.
sources: League Wiki, Tryndamere: Mocking Shout "Reduces the bonus attack damage of nearby enemy champions", slow applies "while facing in the opposite direction of Tryndamere"

audit.whatIsWrong: early says "Bloodlust heals him on every crit and last-hit".
audit.why: Bloodlust does not heal passively. Battle Fury banks Fury from attacks, crits and killing blows; Bloodlust is a cast that consumes the stored Fury to heal. The heal is therefore a discrete, spendable resource Zac can watch and anti-heal, not a trickle attached to his auto-attacks.
audit.corrected: Rewrote early around banking Fury then spending it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage is described as "5 seconds" with no cooldown anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns says only "Unkillable 5s. Out-last it."
audit.why: The number that decides the lane is the 120-second rank-1 cooldown, because it defines a two-minute window in which Zac can actually commit. "Out-last it" without that figure gives no timing to act on.
audit.corrected: Added 120s at rank 1 to spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns, alongside the Spinning Slash figures.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gives Tryndamere 6 of 7 stages against a 50.91% win rate; the full layer gives Zac four.
audit.why: 50.91% over 110 games is a coin flip, and the two layers contradict each other.
audit.corrected: Content chart set to Tryndamere/Skill/Zac/Zac/Tryndamere/Zac/Tryndamere — an even split that keeps his level-1, level-6 and split-push stages. Full layer phases[6] flipped to Tryndamere so both layers agree that the two-item side lane is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[6] reads "Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power" for a matchup whose own late text says "he's a splitpush menace" and "his kit out-1v1s your tank profile".
audit.why: The full layer tells Zac to take the side lane at two items; the content layer tells him the side lane is exactly where Tryndamere beats him. Directly contradictory instructions on the same stage.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[6].why to route Zac into 5v5s instead.

edits.before: His self-heal and crit ramp keep beating your L2 pokes.
edits.after: At 2 Mocking Shout's AD cut does nothing to Zac's W.

edits.before: At 3 his Spinning Slash mobility and DPS still out-duel you.
edits.after: At 3 Zac's E-Q all-in lands before Fury and crits ramp.

edits.before: First-item crit spike lets him out-DPS you even under tower.
edits.after: First item, Heartsteel HP outlasts his pre-ult crit spike.

edits.before: Tryndamere's Spinning Slash (E) resets on kills and his Bloodlust (Q) crits scale with Fury, so avoid extended melee trades where he stacks Fury off your Unstable Matter animations — poke and disengage.
edits.after: Spinning Slash (E) is 12s at rank 1 and doesn't reset on kills — crits shave 1.5s off it, so every crit he lands on you buys his escape back. Deny Fury and the engine slows: Bloodlust spends it as a heal.

edits.before: Undying Rage (R) makes him unkillable for 5 seconds, so a clean 6 all-in almost never works; hold your E engage for after his ult drops, not before.
edits.after: Undying Rage (R) is 5s of unkillable on a 120s rank-1 cooldown — a clean 6 all-in never works, so hold your E until it has been spent, then fight.

edits.before: Stack Fury off your W animations for guaranteed crits
edits.after: Stack Fury off the wave so his crits are guaranteed

edits.before: Tryndamere out-duels you at 1-3: Bloodlust heals him on every crit and last-hit, so your Unstable Matter chip just fuels his Fury — farm safe, don't get baited into extended melee.
edits.after: Tryndamere out-duels you at 1-2: he banks Fury off every attack and crit, then casts Bloodlust to spend it as a heal. Anti-heal blunts that, so farm safe and don't feed extended melee.

edits.before: You get a real window at level 4 when your E gauge + W burst lets you all-in before he has Fury or ult, but from 6 on his Undying Rage flips any solo fight, so respect the 5-second immortality and only commit after it's used.
edits.after: Your window is levels 3-5, before Fury and ult come online — E in and W him down. Mocking Shout only slows you while your back is turned, so walk through him rather than away. From 6 his 5-second Undying Rage flips any solo fight.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — 5s unkillable, 120s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent. - Spinning Slash: 12s at rank 1, and each crit on you shaves 1.5s off it. - Your E: 21s at rank 1, not for chip.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Tryndamere carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-1v1s you in the side lane at two items — carry threat 8.5/10. Take the game in 5v5s where your R decides it, not in a split.

notes: suspectNames flags "Let's Bounce" in spikes[3] — false positive. spikes[3] is accurate and I left it alone. I used the League Wiki for two facts the kit files cannot carry: the Spinning Slash crit-cooldown-reduction (to establish that "resets on kills" is wrong) and that Mocking Shout cuts bonus AD specifically with the slow gated on facing direction.
